@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+---
+const { title } = Astro.props;
+---
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="pt">
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width" />
+    <meta
+      name="description"
+      content="Humannexus - Saúde & Performance Desportiva"
+    />
+    <meta
+      name="description"
+      content="Humannexus - Saúde & Performance Desportiva"
+    />
+    <link rel="sitemap" href="/sitemap-index.xml" />
+    <link rel="icon" type="image/jpg" href="/favicon.png"/> 
+    <!-- Google Font -->
+    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
+    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
+    <link
+      href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@100;200;300;400;500;600;700&display=swap"
+      rel="stylesheet"
+    />
+    <!-- End Google Font -->
+    <meta name="generator" content={Astro.generator} />
+    <title>{title}</title>
+
+    <script is:inline src="https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js" async defer></script>
+
+    <slot name="header" />
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <Header
+      headerStory={headerStory}
+      transition:name="header"
+      transition:persist
+    />
+    <Loading />
+    <main class="flex flex-col max-w-screen-xl mt-8 mx-auto gap-y-8">
+      <Toast />
+      <slot />
+    </main>
+    <Footer
+      footerStory={footerStory}
+      transition:name="footer"
+      transition:persist
+    />
+    <script
+      src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@emailjs/browser@3/dist/email.min.js"
+    ></script>
+    <script is:inline>
+      document.addEventListener("astro:before-preparation", () => {
+        //Restart loading animation
+        document.querySelector("#loading svg image").style.transform = null;
+        document.querySelector("#loading").style.opacity = 100;
+      });
+      document.addEventListener("astro:after-preparation", () => {
+        document.querySelector("#loading").style.opacity = 0;
+      });
+    </script>
+    <style>
+      html {
+        overflow-x: hidden;
+      }
+
+      body {
+        min-height: 100vh;
+        display: flex;
+        flex-direction: column;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </body>
+</html>
